he.text:
On עֶרֶב רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה the morning of the Eve of the New Year the following lines are said by the Reader and repeated by the Congregation—
אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה · יְיָ בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר · הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְיָ׃

en.text:
On the morning of Eve of the New Year the following lines are said by the Reader, and repeated by the Congregation—
Blessed are the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance. With trumpets and sound of cornet, make a joyful noise before the Lord the King.
